findings: OrchestrationReasoning passed the named source-disjoint held-out and ablation controls through the public loader and in-process Machine.Plan for a test-owned deterministic fixture using LEARN-04 pattern id/schema; real LEARN-04 target not exercised.
PromptToTask and SkillSelection are accepted only as partial overlay-level checks; full machine held-out/source-disjoint evaluation is not claimed.
No semantic quality, universal learnability, rollback safety, promotion readiness, common model mutation, runtime host proof, or external AI claim is made.

controls.expected: Exact prompt replay may match but cannot be the only positive evidence.

controls.expected: A shuffled/rejected-signals request must not select the learned pattern.
